requirements.quote: Create a directory `/home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit` (if it does not already exist) and inside it write the file `/home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit/deployment_audit.log` in the EXACT format shown below.
Every character—spaces, commas, newlines, and section headings—must match.

check.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,sys
c=sqlite3.connect('file:/home/user/ci_cd_poc/pipelines.db?mode=ro',uri=True)
s=lambda v:'' if v is None else str(v)
b=[','.join(map(s,r)) for r in c.execute("select id,status,started_at from builds order by id")]
d=[','.join(map(s,r)) for r in c.execute("select id,build_id,env,deployed_at,status from deployments order by id")]
exp='\n'.join(['AUDIT START: 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z','','BUILDS:','id,status,started_at']+b+['','DEPLOYMENTS:','id,build_id,env,deployed_at,status']+d+['','AUDIT END'])
got=open('/home/user/ci_cd_poc/audit/deployment_audit.log').read()
sys.exit(0 if got in (exp,exp+'\n') else 1)
PY

The last line **must** be “AUDIT END” with no trailing spaces.
Do not add extra columns, reorder columns, or change column names.
CSV rows are plain text, comma-separated, with no surrounding quotes.
